Help - Choose a context

up/down     context
Enter       use
Esc         close
?/F1        help
Ctrl+C      exit

Choosing a context makes it the target and runs the checks
against it. dcctl never creates or deletes a context's
cluster. Esc keeps the target it had. Nothing has been
